tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"earlier proposal created in time expired, whether later refund request referred to staff member"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v2/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same units was created in time and then expired, or stopped being valid because the order or this policy changed, before it was paid, a later request for those units is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case. A proposal that the customer replaced or cancelled, that a staff member rejected, or that a handoff closed does not count. A request for an exception to the time limit is refused with this reason."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. A message in the chat confirms nothing. Until a proposal is paid, the customer can cancel it with the button on its card; a message in the chat does not cancel it either. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow, and a staff member who rejects a proposal gives the reason, which the customer is told."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
